title: the probe of the six deleted v1 Lambda functions, v1
description: The document at `legacy/lambdas/{week_anchor}/probe.json` (crucible.keys.legacy_dead_lambdas_key), PRODUCED by nous-ergon-ops/scripts/legacy_dead_lambdas_producer.py and CONSUMED by crucible.gate._clause_dead_lambdas_deleted. alpha-engine-config-I9756's second deliverable is that six zero-invocation v1 functions are deleted; the only surface that answers it is a live AWS read, which a gate may not make, so the producer holds the identity and files the answer here (alpha-engine-config-I9964). One entry per EXACT function name: four live functions share a prefix with one of the six, so a prefix or substring probe would report this deliverable unmet forever against a system that satisfies it. The producer states facts only -- `present` is what the API said, and whether that satisfies the deliverable is the consumer's rule. A probe that could not decide presence is not filed at all: the producer raises, so the document's absence is the reading, never a `present: false` invented from an error.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema. A consumer that does not recognise the version refuses the document rather than guessing.

probed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the probe, timezone-aware. A reading is quoted with when it was taken.

region.description: The AWS region probed. A function absent from one region is not a function that was deleted.

functions.description: One entry per name probed. The consumer refuses a document that does not cover every name it requires, so a producer whose name list drifts from the clause's makes its own documents unmeasurable rather than silently answering a narrower question.

source.description: How the reading was taken, in prose: the API called, that the match was on exact names, and what the producer did NOT decide.

name.description: The EXACT Lambda function name probed. Never a prefix, never a pattern.

present.description: true when the function configuration was returned, false when the API answered ResourceNotFound for that exact name. Any other outcome -- AccessDenied, a throttle, a network error -- is NOT recorded here: the producer raises, because 'we could not ask' rendered as `present: false` would be a permissions failure rendering as a met deliverable.
